summary: Frontend-only test of PR #16 (legal privacy/terms). All 6 requested checks passed with Playwright on the preview URL: /privacy and /terms render (h1, 12/10 h2 sections, mailto links, unique titles 'Privacy Policy | Cavicord' / 'Terms of Service | Cavicord', canonical https://cavicord.tech/privacy|terms, unique meta descriptions); footer Privacy Policy/Terms of Service links navigate via SPA and page smooth-scrolls to top; lead modal consent label shows new text with Privacy Policy (/privacy) and Terms of Service (/terms) links opening in new tab (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer) - new tabs render the legal pages, clicking the links does NOT toggle the consent checkbox and the modal stays open; form NOT submitted. /sitemap.xml served as text/xml with 43 <url> entries incl /privacy and /terms. Regression: homepage rates table renders rows, /guides/i-bonds-vs-cds renders h1 + table + Sources, unknown route shows 404. Zero console errors/page errors. Mobile 390px /terms has no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: src/data/legal.js LEGAL_UPDATED='2026-10-31' -> pages display 'Last updated October 31, 2026'. Fine if that is the real date in the project timeline; double-check it is not a future date relative to deployment.

Preview (dev server) serves the generic home <title> in raw HTML for /privacy and /terms; correct per-page titles only appear after JS / production prerender (prerender.mjs includes both routes) - expected, not a bug.
LegalPage uses window.scrollTo(0,0) which animates due to smooth scroll-behavior (takes ~1s from footer) - cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal pages: data-testid legal-privacy / legal-terms on <article>. Consent label selector: label[for='agree']. Cookie banner [data-testid=cookie-banner] has OK button. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + wait_for_selector; one networkidle goto produced a transient blank page.
